Definition: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
BiblicalUsage: 1) heaven, heavens, sky; 1a) visible heavens, sky; 1a1) as abode of the stars; 1a2) as the visible universe, the sky, atmosphere, etc; 1b) Heaven (as the abode of God)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
